{"consolidated_memory":"**Component: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (malformed record issues)**

This component has experienced FOUR SEPARATE OCCASIONS of malformed record problems, all presenting as decode errors at a single byte offset but with distinct root causes and fixes:

**Occasion 1: [2026-04-10]**
- Trigger: Only clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #2160, branch fix/malformed-record-1)
- Repro: Feed the mixed-encoding sample file
- Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 34 days running
- Location: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)

**Occasion 2: [2026-06-11]**
- Trigger: Only tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query (PR #5201, branch fix/malformed-record-2)
- Repro: Feed the mixed-encoding sample file
- Stack: Python
- Covering test: tests/ingest/test_parser.py
- Result: Backlog cleared 50 minutes after the deploy
- Location: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)

**Occasion 3: [2026-08-03]**
- Trigger: Only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: Listener registered but never removed
- Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #5672, branch fix/malformed-record-3)
- Repro: Feed the mixed-encoding sample file
- Result: Memory settled at 916 MB instead of climbing past 6 GB
- Location: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)

**Occasion 4: [2026-08-25]**
- Trigger: Only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #9930, branch fix/malformed-record-4)
- Repro: Feed the mixed-encoding sample file
- Result: Error rate dropped from 8.9 percent to under 9 per ten thousand
- Location: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)

All four issues present the same signal (decode error at one byte offset) but stem from unrelated causes: resource lifecycle management (cache, listener), query performance (N+1), SDK version compatibility, and timing issues (clock skew)."}
